datasets.name: a90b1c2d
datasets.query:
WITH update_slices AS (
  SELECT
    update_id,
    MAX(update_type) AS update_type,
    MAX(trigger_type) AS trigger_type,
    MIN(period_start_time) AS started_at,
    MAX(period_end_time) AS finished_at,
    COALESCE(MAX(result_state), 'RUNNING') AS result_state,
    GREATEST(COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) - 1, 0) AS restart_count,
    SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time)) AS duration_seconds
  FROM system.lakeflow.pipeline_update_timeline
  WHERE workspace_id = '7405616424934600'
    AND pipeline_id = 'e4b0ab07-e47a-47c4-9394-96ef356d0606'
    AND period_start_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  GROUP BY update_id
)
SELECT update_id, update_type, trigger_type, started_at, finished_at, result_state, restart_count, duration_seconds
FROM update_slices
ORDER BY started_at DESC

datasets.name: b90c2d3e
datasets.query:
WITH current_job AS (
  SELECT paused
  FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE workspace_id = '7405616424934600'
    AND job_id = '1081221935414873'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
), run_slices AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    MAX(run_type) AS run_type,
    MAX(trigger_type) AS trigger_type,
    MIN(period_start_time) AS started_at,
    MAX(period_end_time) AS finished_at,
    COALESCE(MAX(result_state), 'RUNNING') AS result_state,
    MAX(termination_code) AS termination_code,
    SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time)) AS duration_seconds
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
  WHERE workspace_id = '7405616424934600'
    AND job_id = '1081221935414873'
    AND period_start_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  GROUP BY run_id
)
SELECT r.run_id, r.run_type, r.trigger_type, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.result_state, r.termination_code, r.duration_seconds, j.paused AS schedule_paused
FROM run_slices r
CROSS JOIN current_job j
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC

datasets.name: c90d3e4f
datasets.query:
WITH latest_update AS (
  SELECT origin.update_id
  FROM vital_streaming_pipeline_events
  WHERE origin.pipeline_id = 'e4b0ab07-e47a-47c4-9394-96ef356d0606'
    AND origin.update_id IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY timestamp DESC) = 1
), flow_progress AS (
  SELECT
    e.origin.update_id AS update_id,
    COALESCE(e.origin.flow_name, e.origin.dataset_name) AS flow_name,
    e.timestamp AS observed_at,
    GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.details, '$.flow_progress.status') AS flow_status,
    TRY_CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.details, '$.flow_progress.metrics.num_output_rows') AS BIGINT) AS output_rows,
    TRY_CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.details, '$.flow_progress.metrics.backlog_bytes') AS BIGINT) AS backlog_bytes,
    TRY_CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.details, '$.flow_progress.data_quality.dropped_records') AS BIGINT) AS dropped_records
  FROM vital_streaming_pipeline_events e
  JOIN latest_update u ON e.origin.update_id = u.update_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'flow_progress'
    AND COALESCE(e.origin.flow_name, e.origin.dataset_name) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  update_id,
  flow_name,
  MAX_BY(flow_status, observed_at) AS final_status,
  MIN(observed_at) AS started_at,
  MAX(observed_at) AS observed_at,
  SUM(COALESCE(output_rows, 0)) AS output_rows,
  SUM(COALESCE(dropped_records, 0)) AS dropped_records,
  MAX_BY(backlog_bytes, observed_at) FILTER (WHERE backlog_bytes IS NOT NULL) AS backlog_bytes_at_last_refresh,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(observed_at), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS observation_age_minutes
FROM flow_progress
GROUP BY update_id, flow_name
ORDER BY flow_name

datasets.name: d90e4f50
datasets.query:
WITH latest_update AS (
  SELECT origin.update_id
  FROM vital_streaming_pipeline_events
  WHERE origin.pipeline_id = 'e4b0ab07-e47a-47c4-9394-96ef356d0606'
    AND origin.update_id IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY timestamp DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  e.origin.update_id AS update_id,
  expectation.dataset AS dataset,
  expectation.name AS dq_rule,
  SUM(expectation.passed_records) AS passed_records,
  SUM(expectation.failed_records) AS failed_records
FROM vital_streaming_pipeline_events e
JOIN latest_update u ON e.origin.update_id = u.update_id
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(
  FROM_JSON(
    GET_JSON_OBJECT(e.details, '$.flow_progress.data_quality.expectations'),
    'ARRAY<STRUCT<name:STRING,dataset:STRING,passed_records:BIGINT,failed_records:BIGINT>>'
  )
) exploded AS expectation
WHERE e.event_type = 'flow_progress'
GROUP BY e.origin.update_id, expectation.dataset, expectation.name
ORDER BY failed_records DESC, dq_rule

datasets.name: e90f5061
datasets.query:
SELECT
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS observed_at,
  MAX(event_time) AS latest_event_time,
  MAX(eventhub_enqueued_at) AS latest_eventhub_enqueued_at,
  MAX(ingested_at) AS latest_bronze_ingested_at,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(event_time), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS event_age_minutes,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(ingested_at), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS ingestion_age_minutes
FROM silver.vital_events
WHERE event_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS

datasets.name: f9016172
datasets.query:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', eventhub_enqueued_at) AS observed_hour,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MILLISECOND, produced_at, eventhub_enqueued_at) / 1000.0, 0.95), 2) AS producer_to_hub_p95_seconds,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MILLISECOND, eventhub_enqueued_at, ingested_at) / 1000.0, 0.95), 2) AS hub_to_bronze_p95_seconds,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_APPROX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MILLISECOND, produced_at, ingested_at) / 1000.0, 0.95), 2) AS end_to_end_p95_seconds
FROM silver.vital_events
WHERE event_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 8 DAYS
  AND eventhub_enqueued_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', eventhub_enqueued_at)
ORDER BY observed_hour

datasets.name: 0a126283
datasets.query:
SELECT
  dq_rule,
  COUNT(*) AS violated_events,
  MAX(eventhub_enqueued_at) AS last_violation_at
FROM quarantine.vital_events
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(_dq_errors) exploded AS dq_rule
WHERE eventhub_enqueued_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY dq_rule
ORDER BY violated_events DESC, dq_rule

datasets.displayName: Latest batch DQ run per odate and stage
datasets.name: 1b237394
datasets.query:
WITH latest_runs AS (
  SELECT dq_stage, odate, MAX_BY(dq_run_id, checked_at) AS dq_run_id
  FROM dq_run_metrics
  WHERE checked_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 365 DAYS
  GROUP BY dq_stage, odate
)
SELECT
  m.checked_at,
  m.odate,
  m.dq_stage,
  m.dq_run_id,
  m.source_table,
  m.input_rows,
  m.checked_rows,
  m.input_rows - m.checked_rows AS removed_by_cleaning,
  m.valid_rows,
  m.quarantined_rows,
  m.status,
  (m.input_rows >= m.checked_rows AND m.checked_rows = m.valid_rows + m.quarantined_rows) AS reconciliation_ok,
  (p.dq_run_id IS NOT NULL) AS promotion_approved
FROM dq_run_metrics m
JOIN latest_runs r
  ON m.dq_stage = r.dq_stage
 AND m.odate = r.odate
 AND m.dq_run_id = r.dq_run_id
LEFT JOIN dq_promotion_control p
  ON m.dq_stage = p.dq_stage
 AND m.odate = p.odate
 AND m.dq_run_id = p.dq_run_id
ORDER BY m.odate DESC, m.dq_stage, m.source_table
